input.description:
Found by the update-path rows of the QA Regression Runbook during the ZOM-570 gate (Android Submission #135 / iOS Submission #50).

**What goes wrong**
Updating from the N-1 App Store build to iOS Submission #50 loses the player's progress. Before the update the account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins. After the update the save came back at level 1 with 500 coins, and relaunching didn't restore it.

**Device / build**
iPhone 13, iOS 18.6. Installed N-1 from the App Store, then updated to iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50).

**Repro**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store and play past level 200.
2. Install TestFlight 50 (iOS Submission #50) over it.
3. Launch: the save shows level 1 / 500 coins.

**Other update rows (same run)**
- iOS N-2 → #50: pass (level, coins and unlocks kept)
- Android N-1 → #135: pass
- Android N-2 → #135: pass
Fresh-install rows passed on both platforms (Brian's regression matrix).

Source: Brian Foster's "Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135" doc (Drive). Per the runbook, a failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release. Lost progress/coins also makes this a blocker under the ZM submission rules.

input.message:
QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO**. 14 blockers, all listed by key on ZOM-570. The full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50".

The fresh-install matrix is green, but the runbook's update path is not. Updating iOS #50 over the N-1 store build reset the save to level 1 with 500 coins (iPhone 13, from Brian's update-path run). Nobody had filed it, so it's now **ZOM-581**. A failure in an update column blocks on its own.

Other blockers:
• ZOM-435: trophy path stuck again on #135
• ZOM-569: Season Pass empty screen. The fix landed on main at 21:36Z, after both Started lines, so it's not in these builds
• ZOM-567: backend #36 is merged, but the chest rows load hasn't run on prod, so chests still don't land in the inventory
• ZOM-449: low-end freeze
• ZOM-483: infinite lives time lost
• ZOM-560: freezer not delivered on purchase
• ZOM-554: tornado quit leaves the next level unplayable
• ZOM-546: endless board drains
• ZOM-573: Collect&Win crash
• ZOM-576: Season Pass boosters lost
• ZOM-578: tutorial stuck at step 3
• ZOM-559: Samsung victory-screen freeze, not re-checked on #135
• DES-313: level 214 can't be finished

Fixed and verified on the candidates: 503, 506, 557, 561, 434, 558, 564, 517 and 429. 473 also counts as fixed, but nobody has re-checked it on these builds. 23 known issues are listed in the tab.
